name: ufo-fsd
description: UFO-FSD runtime with seven native local substrate surfaces; this checkout is the source of truth

scripts.build: npm run build -w @ufo/core --if-present && npm run build -w @ufo/contract-support --if-present && npm run build:portable
scripts.test: npm run build:portable && npm run test -w @ufo/core && npm run test -w @ufo/contract-support && npm run test -w @ufo/substrate-runtime && node --test tests/*.test.js scripts/*.test.mjs
scripts.doctor: npm run contracts:check && cargo check -p ufo-core-runtime -p ufo-cli
scripts.contracts:check: node scripts/sync-ufo-contracts.mjs --check && node scripts/project-devin-subagents.mjs --check && node scripts/check-routing-free-config.mjs && node scripts/render-seat-tables.mjs --check && node scripts/check-hand-authored-sets.mjs
scripts.contracts:sync: node scripts/sync-ufo-contracts.mjs && node scripts/project-devin-subagents.mjs && node scripts/render-seat-tables.mjs
